retrieval.rag_summary:
Proctor
TightMate represents an airtight sealing tape or grommet accessory catalogued
for building envelope airtightness in Proctor Group systems. Engineered to seal
membrane overlaps, service penetrations, and framing junctions, it prevents
uncontrolled air leakage and convective heat transfer across walls, roofs, and
ceilings. By maintaining airtight continuity, it protects building assemblies
from convective moisture damage and supports stringent blower-door airtightness
targets.
